fee_notes: Standard single-unit Initial Franchise Fee is $45,000 (non-refundable, uniform). Discounts apply under a Multi-Unit Development Agreement: discounted to $33,200 per Shop for 3-4 Shop agreements, and $29,900 per Shop for 5-10 Shop agreements. A Development Area Fee equal to the discounted Initial Franchise Fee applies for each additional Shop beyond the first under a Multi-Unit Development Agreement. Additional fees at signing include a $5,000 Initial Training Fee and a minimum $6,000 grand opening marketing spend (at least $4,000 to franchisor/affiliates and $2,000 to franchisor/affiliates/designated suppliers).
raw_excerpt: When you sign a Franchise Agreement you will pay to us a non-refundable initial franchise fee in the amount of $45,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is fully earned by us upon payment. The method we use to calculate the Initial Franchise Fee is uniform for all franchises that we offer through this Disclosure Document, except that the Initial Franchise Fee will be discounted if you sign a Multi-Unit Development Agreement, as described below. ... (a) Three to Four Shops – If you sign a Multi-Unit Development Agreement that authorizes you to develop three or four Shops, the Initial Franchise Fee is discounted to $33,200 and the Development Area Fee is $33,200 for each additional Shop... (b) Five to 10 Shops – If you sign a Multi-Unit Development Agreement that authorizes you to develop five to 10 Shops, the Initial Franchise Fee is discounted to $29,900 and the Development Area Fee is $29,900 for each additional Shop...
